mcqs.question: Several accessibility problems are reported at once. How do you rank them?

options.text: I connect each barrier to a real task and look first for blocked actions. Visible polish should not outrank someone being unable to continue.
Frequency matters, but severity can outweigh it. I document both so the order remains open to challenge.
I would publish a short rationale and retest the affected tasks. A completed change is not the same as a removed barrier.
I would reject the approach described here and keep the existing routine unchanged.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
